fact_text: On 24 Feb 2026 the KSE-100 index fell to about 164,000 points, then recovered to roughly 166,000 to 167,000.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 24 Feb 2026 | KSE-100 Support & Resistance | HUBC | POL | ATRL & NRL Results' (YouTube, 2026-02-24)

fact_text: The analyst attributed the sharp KSE-100 fall on 24 Feb 2026 to a systemic settlement problem tied to the move from T+2 to T+1 settlement, which hit high-net-worth investors and brokerage houses, not to company earnings or dividends.

fact_text: The analyst said consolidation at 164,000 to 165,000 points would be a positive sign and that this band was the support the market needed during the rollover week.
